question: Who Owns Krispy Kreme?
quick_answer: Krispy Kreme is a publicly traded company, listed on the NASDAQ under the ticker DNUT, so it is owned by its shareholders. Its largest shareholder is JAB Holding, the investment group that bought Krispy Kreme in 2016, took it private, then brought it back to the stock market in 2021. JAB has been reducing its stake over time. Krispy Kreme was founded in 1937 in Winston-Salem, North Carolina.

body.heading: Who owns Krispy Kreme?
body.text: Krispy Kreme is a public company, owned collectively by its shareholders through its NASDAQ listing under the ticker DNUT. Its largest single shareholder is JAB Holding, the investment group also linked to brands like Panera. So Krispy Kreme is publicly traded, with JAB as the biggest owner rather than the sole owner.

body.heading: The JAB story
body.text: JAB Holding bought Krispy Kreme in 2016 and took it private. In 2021 JAB brought Krispy Kreme back to the stock market through an IPO, keeping a large stake. Since then JAB has gradually reduced its holding, though it has remained the company's largest shareholder.

body.heading: The brand's roots
body.text: Krispy Kreme was founded in 1937 in Winston-Salem, North Carolina, and became famous for its Original Glazed doughnuts and the 'Hot Light' that signals fresh doughnuts coming off the line.
